One of any fighter's special moves (with the exception of Axl Low, Testament and Justice) can be charged. Depending on the level of the Charge gauge, that fighter's attacks become more powerful.
Chaos Attacks are attacks which can be performed either either by completing the Chaos Gauge, or by tapping into the Chaos Mode. Fighters automatically enter Chaos Mode when their health reaches the half-way point (when their green health bar is fully-depleted). The fighter is then surrounded by a red aura and has the ability to perform an unlimited amount of Chaos Attacks.
There is a way to defeat your opponent in the entire battle. These are called Instant Kill. Initiate one by pressing    when your fighter is close to the opponent. The background will turn red.
